items.title: Yet another performance degradation research induced by mutex in an unexpected hotpath in a mature database code.
items.blurb: Couple years ago Marko decided to remove a partioned LRU cache from MariaDB(it is still used in MySQL code). There was a lot of doubt regarding this but his solution worked as good as a previous one for most of microbenchmarks except one.

items.title: Find yours before prod does
items.blurb: Adding a 5-row lookup table to a 9-table billing query flips the plan from 0.3ms nested loops to 467ms hash joins. The cause is join_collapse_limit = 8, a default Postgres has shipped since 2005. SQL Server and MySQL don't have this cliff.

items.title: pgVolvra: Flashback-Style 'Undo' for Bad UPDATEs and DELETEs
items.blurb: pgVolvra: an open source extension that puts back the exact rows a mistake changed, and leaves everything else alone.

items.title: pgrust 0.4 Beta: The Rust Rewrite of Postgres Opens Up
items.blurb: pgrust v0.4-beta introduces the Gravity query engine, MVCC and writes for pgrcolumnar, automatic memory management, and native jsonb statistics.
